album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 7

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on G in Reng-e Nava. The line peaks at D4 (283.7 Hz) at 0:27.2. It closes on the tonic (G3 → G3 → G3 → G3 → G3 → G3).
